comment: Pinned IronKernel network sources for IronKernel 64 (private repository, not published). tools/setup_ironkernel.py fetches each entry at its commit into ironkernel/src/<name>/ (gitignored), checks tree_sha256 and writes SOURCE.txt from tools/ironkernel/<name>.SOURCE.txt. The public repository carries only the prebuilt netlist (fpga/netlist) and library (fw_1541/lib) made from these trees. Bump a version: change commit, run setup with --update-hashes, review the diff, update the SOURCE.txt note.

netcore_repo.comment: Private repository with the ik64_net_core wrapper, the netlist and library build scripts and the network firmware glue. tools/setup_ironkernel.py clones it into ironkernel/ when that folder is missing. OWNER TO SET: the user creates the private GitHub repository and puts its URL here; until then the local ironkernel/ repository is authoritative.
